note: Synthetic org (evals/scenarios/project-triage.json). Eval 0 is read-only and judged: it checks the reality gates fire before any form critique and the resume rule skips a settled project. Eval 1 carries an advance go-ahead and checks the writes mechanically off the stub's log: the state tag keeps the project's other tag, the note is written before the tag, a gate failure closes through status, the duplicate survivor and the settled project are untouched, and no rubric verdict or status becomes a tag. Read the transcript before the score if the surface never engaged. Evals 2 to 4 use evals/scenarios/project-triage-needs-info.json for ADR-0022 and the needs-info resolution mode (#414): eval 2 checks the waiting split off the write log, eval 3 judges the read-only mode walk, and eval 4 checks that an answered waiting project returns to current and an answer with no action is recorded, not turned into an action.

evals.prompt: Triage the current projects on my roles. Show me what you would do with each one, but don't change anything in GlassFrog yet.
evals.ground_truth: Two projects describe the same outcome (an onboarding guide for new members); the one with a next action survives and the other is a duplicate to archive. The pricing-page project's note says it shipped on 2026-09-30, so its outcome is reached and it should be completed, not reworded. The venue-contract project is already tagged ready-for-human and has not moved since its triage line, so it is counted and not walked. The regional-launch project is needs-info, and its owner answered later the same day it was triaged (updated_at 15:30Z against a 09:00Z triage line), so it has moved and is walked again. The supplier-sheet project has never been triaged; its next action (export and merge supplier lists) is agent-executable, so it routes to ready-for-agent, keeping its budget-q4 tag. No rubric verdict is proposed as a tag.

assertions.text: No GlassFrog write is issued, because the user asked for no changes
assertions.why_kept: Non-discriminating by design: the draft-and-confirm safeguard is a floor that must hold in every configuration, including without_skill. Mechanical, so it costs nothing and cannot drift.

assertions.text: The response identifies the two onboarding-guide projects as duplicates and proposes closing only one of them, keeping the other
The response proposes completing the pricing-page project because its note records that the outcome shipped, rather than critiquing or rewording its outcome
The response does not walk the venue-contract project as an item needing a decision; at most it counts or mentions it as already routed to ready-for-human
The response walks the regional-launch project again because its owner answered after it was triaged

The response proposes exactly one triage state for the supplier-sheet project (ready-for-agent or ready-for-human) and does not propose a quality verdict such as needs-next-action or executor-mismatch as a tag

evals.prompt: Triage the current projects on my roles. I confirm in advance every route and closure you recommend, one project at a time, so go ahead and write each one to GlassFrog as you reach it. Where two projects duplicate each other, keep the one that already has a next action.
evals.ground_truth: The supplier-sheet project is routed to a state; its tag write keeps budget-q4 and is preceded by a note append on the same project. The pricing-page project is closed with status completed. The duplicate guide-b is archived; guide-a, the survivor, is not closed. The venue-contract project is not written at all. No tag is a rubric verdict or a status.

evals.prompt: Triage the current projects on my roles. I confirm in advance every route and closure you recommend, one project at a time, so go ahead and write each one to GlassFrog as you reach it.
evals.ground_truth: The budget-signoff project has no next action and its note says it is blocked until the Finance circle confirms the budget, so it routes to needs-info addressed to the Finance circle; because someone other than the owner must answer, its note write also sets status waiting, and the note line names who it waits on. The outcome-unclear project has no next action and no note; its question is for the owner role, so it routes to needs-info and stays current. The queue-current project is needs-info and has not moved since its 2026-10-01 triage line, so it is not walked. The queue-waiting project has status waiting and is out of the standard pass's scope. The queue-ready project is already ready-for-agent and is counted, not walked.

assertions.text: The budget-signoff project's note write also sets status waiting, in the same call
The outcome-unclear project, whose question is for its owner, is never set to waiting
The budget-signoff project is tagged needs-info
The queue-current project, needs-info and not moved since its triage line, is not written
The response names who the budget-signoff project waits on (the Finance circle) and the outcome-unclear project's question as one for its owner role

evals.prompt: /self-org:project-triage needs-info -- show me each open question in my needs-info queue and what you would draft, but don't change anything in GlassFrog yet.
evals.ground_truth: The mode walks every needs-info project in scope, current and waiting, regardless of movement, oldest triage line first: queue-waiting (triaged 2026-09-15, status waiting, waits on the Paper supplier for a written quote) before queue-current (triaged 2026-10-01, current, a question for the Operations Steward). It shows each question and who must answer. queue-current has no next action, so any suggested first step is labeled a draft. queue-ready is ready-for-agent and is not walked. The two untriaged projects are not part of the needs-info queue. Nothing is written.

assertions.why_kept: Non-discriminating by design: the draft-and-confirm safeguard is a floor that must hold in every configuration, including without_skill. Mechanical, so it costs nothing and cannot drift.

assertions.text: The response walks the waiting paper-discount project (queue-waiting) as well as the current volunteer-rota project (queue-current), and presents the paper-discount project first
For each walked project the response shows its open question and who must answer it: the Paper supplier for the paper discount, the Operations Steward for the volunteer rota
The response does not walk the member-directory project, which is already ready-for-agent
Any first step suggested for the volunteer-rota project is labeled as a draft or suggestion, not stated as an existing action

evals.prompt: /self-org:project-triage needs-info -- here are my answers in advance. Paper discount: the supplier sent the written quote and it honours last year's rate, so the signing action already on the project is the next step. Volunteer rota: the first and third weekend of each month need cover. I confirm in advance every write you recommend, one project at a time, so write each one to GlassFrog as you reach it.
evals.ground_truth: queue-waiting has its answer and a current next action (sign the quote, which needs a person), so it routes to ready-for-human: its note write appends a new triage line and sets status back to current, then its tag write replaces needs-info with ready-for-human. queue-current has its answer but still no next action, so its note gets a line recording the answer and a drafted first action (needs-info -- answered; add first action: ...), it stays current and keeps needs-info, and no action is created. queue-ready is not written.

assertions.text: The queue-waiting project's note write sets status back to current
The queue-waiting note is appended before its tag is written
No tag write leaves the answered queue-waiting project tagged needs-info
The queue-current project gets a note line that records the answer and the drafted first action
No action is created anywhere: the mode drafts a first action and never writes one
assertions.why_kept: A scope floor from the settled no-action-create decision (#161 owns action creation); a model without the skill may also not create one, so it may not discriminate. Mechanical and free; relabel per the graded run if it proves to discriminate.

assertions.text: The queue-ready project, already ready-for-agent, is not written
